content: There is no history; only biography.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Abstract historical movements are ultimately the personal choices, struggles, and convictions of individual human beings. The epic of humanity is mirrored in your own soul.
practicalInsight: Realize that your personal decisions are writing a living chapter in the story of your family and community.
reflectionPrompt: What kind of biography are your daily habits currently writing?
